Hey, I’m Dan 👋 A Brit who swapped life in the UK for Australia’s sunny Gold Coast. On this channel, I share my experiences of moving abroad, the culture shocks, the things I love, the challenges, and everything in between.

This is an honest look at what life’s really like when you take the leap and start over in a new country.

If you’re curious about Australia, thinking of moving here, or just love travel and lifestyle stories, you’ll feel right at home.
